findings.message: The scope string in the recorded result has missing spaces ("fullP11", "GPUheap"). It is a release-evidence disclaimer, and the garbled text hurts readability and any text matching on it. The README spells it "full P11/native/GPU heap". Note that process-result.json is hashed in INDEX.json, so editing it requires updating its sha256 and byte count.
findings.suggestion: Fix the spacing to "full P11/native/GPU heap certification" and regenerate the INDEX.json hash and byte count for process-result.json.
findings.evidence: "scope": "bounded preview resource regression, not fullP11/native/GPUheap certification"
